title: Alaskan Sled Dog Adventure Tour from Anchorage
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the thrill of an authentic Alaskan sled dog ride in Big Lake, just a scenic drive from Anchorage. Spend up to an hour gliding through snowy trails with expert mushers, all while learning about sled dog culture and the famous Iditarod. This tour offers a unique blend of adventure and storytelling, allowing guests to meet the dogs, interact with adorable puppies, and discover how these remarkable teams are trained. With round-trip transportation from Anchorage and winter gear assistance, this unforgettable experience is perfect for families, friends, and adventure seekers.

- Enjoy a guided sled dog ride with expert mushers for 1 hour
- Meet and interact with sled dogs and puppies
- Round-trip transportation provided from Anchorage
- Total tour time is 5 - 6 hours, including scenic drives
